title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE KOREA RESEARCH INSTITUTE FOR LOCAL ADMINISTRATION SUPPORT ACT
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) This Decree prescribes matters delegated by the Korea Research Institute for Local Administration Support Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") and matters necessary for its enforcement. <Amended Oct. 29, 2015>

Article 2 (Operation and Management of Fund)
(1) The Korea Research Institute for Local Administration (hereinafter referred to as the "Institute") shall establish and manage a separate account for the fund formed from contributions.
(2) Where the Institute intends to reduce the principal of the fund, it shall obtain approval from the Minister of the Interior and Safety. <Amended Feb. 29, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>
(3) The fund shall not be used for any purpose other than the Institute's facilities and operation.
(4) The Institute shall establish detailed rules for the operation and management of the fund and obtain approval from the Minister of the Interior and Safety. The same shall apply to amendments to those rules. <Amended Feb. 29, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>

Article 3 (Procedures for Payment of Contributions, etc.)
(1) By October 31 of each year, the Institute shall submit to the Special Metropolitan City Mayor, Metropolitan City Mayor, Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Do Governor or Special Self-Governing Province Governor (hereinafter referred to as the "Mayor/Do Governor") a request for contributions for the following fiscal year, accompanied by the following documents, and shall report this fact without delay to the Minister of the Interior and Safety: <Amended Feb. 29, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Oct. 29, 2015; Jul. 26, 2017; Jan. 5, 2021>
1. Business plan for the following fiscal year;
2. Estimated statement of financial position and estimated statement of profit or loss for the following fiscal year;
3. Other documents necessary to clarify the contents of the budget.
(2) When a budget for contributions has been confirmed, the Mayor/Do Governor shall notify the Institute.
(3) If the Institute wishes to receive the confirmed contributions notified under paragraph (2), it shall submit an application for payment, accompanied by a plan for the execution of funds, to the Mayor/Do Governor.

Article 4 (Approval of Business Plans and Budgets)
(1) Pursuant to Article 6 of the Act, the Institute shall submit its business plan and budget to the Minister of the Interior and Safety for approval at least one month before the beginning of each fiscal year. <Amended Feb. 29, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>
(2) Once the Institute has obtained approval from the Minister of the Interior and Safety under paragraph (1), it shall notify the Mayor/Do Governor of its contents without delay. <Amended Feb. 29, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>

Article 5 (Treatment of Surplus) The Institute shall first use any surplus in each fiscal year to cover losses carried forward from the previous fiscal year and shall incorporate any remaining balance into revenue for the following fiscal year or transfer it to the fund.

Article 6 (Submission of Statements of Settlement of Accounts) Within two months after the close of each fiscal year, the Institute shall submit to the Minister of the Interior and Safety the statement of revenue and expenditure for that fiscal year under Article 7 of the Act, together with the following documents: <Amended Feb. 29, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017; Jan. 5, 2021>
1. Statement of financial position and statement of profit or loss;
2. Comparative statement of the annual business plan and its implementation results;
3. Opinion of a certified public accountant pursuant to Article 7 of the Act.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 11961, Sep. 11, 1986>
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
